text_block_list.text:
Today marks the end of our time at
summer camp.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Geez... Youth sure is fleeting, huh? I
can't believe
camp is already over.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:

The Arima
Kinen will be here before we
know it.
text_block_list.name: Марузенски

text_block_list.text:
I'm going to use what I learned at camp
to have
the best race possible!
